rationale: After 29 minutes in the trade, the expected breakout above $35.08 has stalled with maximum favorable excursion reaching only 0.31%. Price has now lost both the psychological $35.00 level and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($35.04), closing at the low of the most recent candle ($34.94). Exiting now cuts the failed momentum attempt early rather than waiting for a test of the $34.75 stop, though strong session VWAP support ($34.55) and a bullish broader market prevent flipping short.
